title: Figma introduces new tools for agents and code layers
excerpt: Figma reveals new features to control how agents operate on its platform alongside an open beta release for code layers.
body_html: Figma has announced new capabilities designed to establish how agents function across its platform. Along with these updates for agent workflows, the company is also launching its code layers feature in an open beta release. The additions aim to expand platform functionality and give users more control over automated interactions and coding layers within their projects.
